# L3 Modules

Short modules live here as sections. A module that grows past about 100 lines moves to the `L3-modules/` folder.

## Member cards

Members get a numbered card that is scanned at the desk. Lost cards are blocked and replaced with a new number.

The card number is never reused. A replaced card keeps the history of the old one.

## Loan desk

The loan desk records which item leaves with which member and when it is due. It refuses a loan when the member has too many open loans.

### Limits

The default limit is five open loans per member.

## Item catalogue

The catalogue lists every lantern, book and game with a shelf code and a condition note.
